subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

__Little __that I knew of the English language was not sufficient to make me an English teacher.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Little"** means a small amount or hardly any. (थोड़ा)

 
 
• **Example: Little** did I know about the surprise party they had planned for me.
 
 
 
• **"The little" **refers to the small amount that is available or known, and it emphasizes whatever small quantity there is. (थोड़ा सा)
 
 
• **Example: The little** money he had was not enough to buy the book.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate substitution for the underlined segment is **'The little' **.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **A little **(थोड़ा सा): A small amount but more than none.

 
 
• **Example: A little** knowledge can be a dangerous thing.
 
 
 
• **So little **(बहुत कम): Extremely small amount.
 
 
• **Example: **He had **so little** time to complete the project.
 
 
 
• **Very little** (बहुत कम): Almost no amount.
 
 
• **Example:** She had** very little** interest in the subject.
